R575.note: Escapes rawComment at the correct point using the existing entity-mapping pattern; no other observable change.

R576.note: Path.GetRelativePath + rooted-path check correctly closes the sibling-prefix bypass and the Path.Combine absolute-path discard; legitimate paths under base dir still succeed.

R577.note: Moves term into Jinja2 context var instead of string concatenation, relying on real autoescaping default; no other behavior change.

R578.note: Allowlist switch replaces $$cmd() dispatch; both legitimate commands preserved, returns same string type for unknown input.

R579.note: Rejects keys with protocol metacharacters (space/null/control) per memcached key spec; this validation is the fix itself, not an unrelated restriction.

R580.note: Adds can:update,order middleware matching sibling routes' established pattern; the authorization check is the fix itself.

R581.note: session_regenerate_id(true) added post-auth, standard fixation fix, no other behavior change.

R582.note: Plaintext listener now only redirects to HTTPS, matching the code's own stated original intent; disclosed and closes the CSRF-exposed path.

R583.note: createCipheriv + PBKDF2 + random salt/iv, standard fix; salt:iv:ciphertext format change is necessary for correct decryption and disclosed, no consumer shown in scope to break.

R584.note: Removes the attacker-controlled entity map assignment entirely, which is itself the vulnerability; no legitimate design depended on user data defining XML entities.

R585.note: crypto.randomBytes(16).toString('hex') replaces Math.random(); format change to 32-char hex is disclosed and doesn't reject any legitimate use.

R586.note: fgets + truncation-peek + drain correctly implements the stated contract: fits-in-line copies through, too-long-for-line rejects with no leftover bytes queued.

R587.note: Adds UseAntiforgery() middleware and explicit ValidateRequestAsync() call; preserves 202 Accepted and QueueAsync() call for authorized requests with valid tokens, matching the stated contract.

R588.note: Swaps GroovyShell for JEXL3, an appropriate restricted-expression-language fix, but silently changes the formula DSL - any already-stored admin formula using Groovy-specific syntax beyond basic math/ternary would now fail (falling back to basePrice) without this being flagged as a migration risk.

R589.note: Captures bytesSent() before reset() eliminates the UAF; returns the same value a correct call would have produced, no other change.

R590.note: Statement->PreparedStatement with setString bind parameter, standard fix, no other observable change.
